All five observed same-process residual records in the post-setting fresh processes remain unmodified. Historical achievable removal is 42 flips; removing 87 is explicitly an optimistic bound.

**Cost audit.** All **43,138** historical records reconcile exactly, individually, to **659,906.88011 AIU**. The tested adaptive TTL policies still lose to 1h-for-all: **+5.9-24.2%** before and **+7.2-11.3%** after. The **0.9% / 5.4%** hindsight improvement concerns each seat's best fixed TTL, not an oracle for every possible adaptive policy. Keeping 1h and building nothing is supported by this evidence.
